component.name: LatamPay Platform
component.description: LatamPay S.A. consolidated software bill of materials across customer-facing and internal services. SYNTHETIC DATA for workshop use only.

properties.name: latampay:note
properties.value: Log4j (log4j-core) was fully removed across all services during the 2022 remediation program and replaced with Logback. It is intentionally NOT present in this SBOM.

components.name: payment-gateway
components.description: Internet-facing card payment gateway. Tier-0, in PCI-DSS scope. Uses database credentials for card authorization flows.

components.name: Apache Struts
components.description: Web framework used by payment-gateway. Uses OGNL expression evaluation.

components.name: Spring Boot
components.description: Used by customer-portal backend, reconciliation-service, notification-service, and document-service.

components.name: Logback
components.description: Logging framework. Replaced Log4j across the fleet in 2022.

components.name: customer-portal
components.description: Internet-facing self-service portal. React SPA + Spring Boot backend with login and return URL redirect flow.

components.name: Nginx
components.description: Reverse proxy / TLS termination in the DMZ.

components.name: reconciliation-service
components.description: Internal money-movement reconciliation service that consumes serialized settlement messages from a message queue, reconciles transactions, and exposes internal admin endpoints. Tier-1.

properties.name: latampay:note
properties.value: Deserializes Java objects from the settlement queue.

components.name: document-service
components.description: Internal service handling upload/download of customer KYC documents. Tier-1, stores PII.

components.name: notification-service
components.description: Internal notification service that delivers outbound webhooks/HTTP callbacks to merchant-supplied callback URLs. Runs in a cloud VPC.

properties.name: latampay:note
properties.value: Makes outbound HTTP requests to URLs configured by merchants; runs in a VPC with a cloud metadata endpoint reachable.

components.name: corporate-directory
components.description: Internal LDAP/Active Directory used for employee authentication. An internal admin tool builds LDAP filters from form input.

components.name: OpenLDAP client
components.description: Used by internal admin tool against corporate-directory.

components.name: PostgreSQL
components.description: Primary relational datastore for all services. No MySQL/MariaDB anywhere in the estate.

properties.name: latampay:not_in_estate
properties.value: Log4j (removed 2022); MySQL/MariaDB; legacy SOAP/XML gateway (decommissioned 2024); WordPress
